Hi Ethan (and team),

Thanks — attaching the invoice and our standard payment terms. Quick answers:

- The $18,500 deposit covers 50% of the contracted room rental + flat catering minimum. Final invoice will reflect exact catering headcount.
- We can accept an ACH invoice from Acme (net 30) OR a single payment via virtual card. We do not take split payments on our portal, but we will accept two separate transactions if you provide two cards with distinct authorizations.
- The venue places a separate incidental authorization of up to $2,000 on the card at check-in; that hold is released within 5–7 business days after check-out provided no charges are posted.

Document attached: venue_deposit_invoice.pdf

If you go the virtual-card route, please include: cardholder name, single-use or multi-use flag, limit, and expiration date (we can do a 7-day window covering Jun 14–20). If Acme will pay by invoice to AP, please send the AP contact and PO number.
